note: 112-acre former city water-supply lake south of LaBelle. The small designated campground on the south shore, west of the boat ramp, has numbered gravel back-in spurs with tables off a gravel loop, looking north through a belt of trees to the lake, with a shelterhouse and privy nearby. Camping is only at the numbered sites, except walk-in camping outside the firearms deer and turkey seasons. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Individual Campsites' (+ walk/float/backpack open camping), Rule 140 standard; brochure 'Camping is permitted only at numbered sites in the designated campground'; map (06/15) '6 Sites' campground west of the boat ramp = GIS 532 = stored pin; six ~20 m gravel back-in spurs on imagery. Lakeview confirmed (spur ends 27-46 m from the water through a tree belt). Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual; sites.count 6 new. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack(no Deer/Turkey), Individual Campsites'; Rule 140 standard, no special-use-permit-only rule, no Rule 101 (MDC bought the lake from the city in 2003). Brochure: 'Camping is permitted only at numbered sites in the designated campground and may not exceed 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period. Groups of more than 10 campers require a special use permit. No unattended open campfires allowed. Quiet hours are from 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m.'; 'Walk-in camping is allowed year-round EXCEPT during all firearms deer and turkey seasons. During these seasons camping is only allowed on or adjacent to graveled area parking lots.' Map (06/15): 'Primitive Camping-Individual Sites' labelled '6 Sites' on the south shore west of the boat ramp, with a shelterhouse and privy. Imagery: six gravel back-in spurs about 20 m long, each with a table, off a gravel loop - a 23-ft rig fits.

WATERFRONT (lakeview, confirmed with a caveat): the spur ends are 27-46 m from the water (eastern spurs closest), across a belt of deciduous trees on the bank; leaf-off imagery shows the lake plainly through the bare trees, leaf-on imagery shows the belt in full canopy, so the summer view is filtered. The tree belt rules out on-water. No official campsite photos were found to settle the summer view; lakeview is the matching value and stays.
PIN: stored 40.09164,-91.90254 = GIS 532, on the loop road in front of the spurs; fine.
CLUSTERS: one campground; the walk-in open camping isn't drive-in. near.py finds no other entry within 3 km.
